title: Fail fast on production Redis and strengthen security gates
goal: Make production dependencies and vulnerability scanning enforceable and observable.
acceptanceCriteria: Security scan failures are not silently swallowed
humanGate: Maintainer approval for CI blocking policy and Redis requirement

humanGateDecision.authorization: Maintainer instruction 2026-09-23: authorize the agent to complete the remaining A-round items directly, including confirming each task's human gate.
humanGateDecision.decision: CI blocking policy and Redis requirement confirmed: production (or PANTHEON_REDIS_REQUIRED=true) must fail fast without Redis; push-to-main keeps enforcing the security scans; PR runs may stay report-only for dependency-vulnerabilities and workflow-security with repo-maintainer ownership and per-release review; /health must report database, migrations and redis.
